propositions: Mapped but nonexistent Jira project keys pass syntactic validation but fail deep in fan-out as ACLI errors, leaving live mutation vulnerable to partial failure.
legacy_default projects are resolved unvalidated, causing unguarded CREATE storms into wrong or nonexistent targets when cross-project write guards exclude legacy creates.
Preflight must validate every project the reconcile pass could touch (mapped projects, legacy_default, and configured query_project fallback) is visible to the bot before any outbound mutation.
Probe uses existing AcliClient._direct_rest_get transport against Jira Cloud GET /rest/api/3/project/search endpoint with paginated collection and hard-cap fail-closed guarantees.
Preflight only runs for mutating passes (skipping preview/dry-run/reconcile-check) and Cloud backends (backend == 'jira'), with observable skip messages and no crash on failure.
